اقتفيتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَفَيْتُمْ (iqtafaytum) /iq.ta.faj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اُقْتُفِيتُمْ (uqtufītum) /uq.tu.fiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
